GlobalGameStats.title: GlobalGameStats
GlobalGameStats.description: Aggregated community ratings, recommendations, and 100% completion runs for a game.

coverImageUrl.description: URL of the game cover image.

averageRating.description: Aggregated average rating (0.0 to 5.0) across all users.

ratingSum.description: Total sum of ratings submitted by users.

ratingCount.description: Total count of users who rated this game.

recommendCount.description: Total number of users who recommend this game.

total100PercentRuns.description: Total number of users who completed a 100% run.

isCommunityEntry.description: Mandatory filter flag (always true) for secure community list queries.

lastUpdatedBy.description: UID of the user who last synced stats.

UserGameContribution.title: UserGameContribution
UserGameContribution.description: Authenticated user's personal synced game state and contribution to global stats.

gameId.description: External API ID of the game.

coverImageUrl.description: Cover image URL of the game.

isPlayed.description: Whether the user has played the game.

isOwned.description: Whether the user owns the game (Library vs Wishlist).

is100Percent.description: Whether the user achieved a 100% Platinum/Gold run.

isRecommended.description: Whether the user recommends the game.

AdminApiSecrets.title: AdminApiSecrets
AdminApiSecrets.description: Encrypted/protected API keys stored in the Cloud Admin Vault, accessible exclusively to the verified Admin.

twitchClientId.description: Twitch Client ID for IGDB API v4.

twitchClientSecret.description: Twitch Client Secret for IGDB OAuth2.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the admin who updated the vault.

/global_game_stats/{gameId}.description: Global aggregated community ratings, recommendations, and 100% completion counts per game.

/users/{userId}/game_contributions/{game.description: Per-user cloud backup and contribution ledger for accurate global aggregation.

/admin_vault/{secretDocId}.description: Zero-trust admin vault storing API keys in the cloud, readable and writable exclusively by the verified admin.
